import base64, hashlib, json, zlib
from pathlib import Path
import guala_body_active_load_regime as probe
e=json.loads(Path("docs/evidence/FB-01aj-constraint-work.json").read_text())
old=list(e["complete_original_cases"])
for item in e["recovered_records"]:
    raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(item["payload_zlib_base64"]))
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item["raw_sha256"]
    old.extend(json.loads(raw)["cases"])
controls={(r["configuration"],r["name"],r["effort"]):r for r in old}
def emit(text, **kwargs):
    value=json.loads(text)
    if "load" in value:
        r=value["load"]; control=controls[(r["configuration"],r["name"],r["effort"])]
        w=r["constraint_work"]; discrete=w["discrete_update"]
        for key, previous in control.items():
            if key=="wall_seconds": continue
            if key=="constraint_work":
                assert all(w[k]==v for k,v in previous.items()), "prior constraint record changed"
            else:
                assert r[key]==previous, ("prior body record changed",key)
        assert discrete["completed_steps"]==w["substeps"]
        raw=json.dumps(discrete,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False).encode()
        value={"measurement":{"configuration":r["configuration"],"name":r["name"],"effort":r["effort"],
            "h_us":r["step_us"],"prior_record_exact":True,"ordinary_successor_exact":w["ordinary_successor_exact"],
            "signed_energy_closure_j":discrete["work_j"]["energy_closure"],
            "absolute_energy_closure_j":discrete["sum_absolute_discrete_energy_closure_j"],
            "impulse_energy_bound_j":discrete["sum_absolute_impulse_energy_residual_bound_j"],
            "constraint_work_discrete_j":discrete["work_j"]["constraint"],
            "physical_balance_j":discrete["physical_balance_with_discrete_constraint_j"],
            "peak_step_closure_j":discrete["max_absolute_discrete_energy_closure_j"],
            "raw_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"raw_bytes":len(raw),
            "payload_zlib_base64":base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw)).decode()}}
    print(json.dumps(value,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
probe.print=emit
result=probe.run(configurations=("finer_constant_impedance","fixed_response_half_step","fixed_response_quarter_step"),stream=True,constraint_work=True)
del result["cases"]
print(json.dumps({"summary":result},allow_nan=False),flush=True)
